snippet.description:
The trial of Lindsey Clancy, the mother accused of killing her three children in Massachusetts, has stirred conversation over the treatment of postpartum depression. While Clancy’s case is distinctly rare and involves potential postpartum psychosis, postpartum depression is remarkably common. 

Vox’s Dylan Scott reached out to organizations across the country that are offering effective treatment with a simple approach: peer support from other women.

Learn more: https://www.vox.com/health/501565/lindsay-clancy-trial-postpartum-depression-psychosis
